# AI fitness influencer and gym coach characters that pass image filters

**A role, a build and one signature colour become a fitness character sheet, in catalog wording that gets past false blocks.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_1312937b4575.webp" alt="A fitness coach character sheet: a muscular woman with a buzz cut in a lime sports bra and black leggings shown front, side and back." width="480"></p>

Makes AI fitness characters on varg (coaches, gym creators, athletes, bodybuilders) with real muscle and skin, a locked signature outfit and colour, and catalog-style wording that gets sports bras, leggings and shirtless athletes past false moderation blocks. Builds the character sheet ready for workout scenes and video. Use when someone asks for a fitness influencer, gym girl or gym guy, a trainer for an app, an athlete for an activewear or supplement ad, or a character in a sports bra that keeps getting blocked. Part of varg-character-design (definition, sheet, reuse in video).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-character-fitness                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-character-fitness --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | Fitness character sheet and workout stills |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$0.07 per sheet (Seedream 5 Pro, tested) |
